_meta.title: v6p5 cnn backbone with batch normalization
_meta.summary: Keep v6p5 local high-res observation and add BatchNorm2d in CNNQNetwork conv trunk for training stability.

self_check: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p5 --self-check
conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p5 --self-check

smoke.train: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p5 --episodes 300 --out v6p5_bn_smoke300
smoke.infer: conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p5 --models v6p5_bn_smoke300 --runs 3 --out v6p5_bn_smoke300

full.train: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p5 --out v6p5_bn_full3000
full.infer: conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p5 --models v6p5_bn_full3000 --runs 20 --out v6p5_bn_full3000
